name: Software Developer

sections.daily_work: Build, test, debug, collaborate. Write code that powers apps, websites, and systems.
sections.learning: Programming languages (Python, JavaScript, etc.), frameworks, version control, problem-solving fundamentals.
sections.pay: Varies by location and experience. Entry-level often starts around $50,000-$80,000 USD. Always verify current data for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Computer science degree, self-learning with online resources, coding bootcamps, internships, open-source contributions.

try_in_real_life: Complete a beginner programming exercise (try freeCodeCamp or Codecademy)
Build and share a small project on GitHub
Talk to a developer about their day-to-day work
Research entry-level job postings in your region
sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Occupational Outlook Handbook (bls.gov/ooh)
